note: Expectation index for the EXAMPLE records in this folder. schema_valid was checked against control.schema.json with a JSON Schema validator (see HANDOFF G-01). Every other field is a design expectation for the G-02 checker and has NOT been executed. 'current' assumes today's state: no trusted verifier exists, so trust_anchor/verification values in records are unverified claims. 'if_anchors_verified' assumes a G-03 verifier outside Main confirms the non-Main anchors. Example grants are EXAMPLE_INACTIVE, so as shipped no example can open an effect. A record that is schema-valid but lacks operation facts the checker needs is BLOCKED with OPERATION_DESCRIPTOR_INCOMPLETE; schema-valid never means ALLOW. Routes follow the match semantics in ROUTING_POLICY.json (OR between clauses, AND between fields, conditions_all/conditions_any explicit).

cases.scenario: New draft in working/ inside a standing group grant

expected_if_grant_active.why: Row needs only a cooperative grant reference in scope; no Reviewer, no task record, no re-approval.

cases.scenario: Off-recipe register write with PRE_EFFECT and PRE_INTEGRATION reviews bound to the same digests

expected_current.why: Intent, grant and reviewer eligibility are VERIFIED only by the record's own claim; no verifier outside Main exists yet.

expected_if_anchors_verified.why: Bindings, phases and verdicts line up; still not semantic proof of the content.

cases.schema_error: schema_version must equal law.cvf.control/1; unknown versions are refused, not interpreted

cases.scenario: Review bound to input-A; effect requested on input-B (source revision 2)

expected_if_anchors_verified.why: Only the changed input part needs re-review.

cases.scenario: PRE_INTEGRATION verdict BLOCKED; Main marks ACCEPTED_FOR_INTEGRATION with requirements claimed MET

expected_current.why: Structure is valid because Main's requirement claims are MET; the acceptance point must read the bound verdict, which Main cannot drop.

cases.scenario: PRE_INTEGRATION PASS bound to output-X; artifact digest is now output-Y
Intent ref anchored MAIN_DECLARED, self-marked VERIFIED, digest consistent everywhere

expected_if_anchors_verified.why: MAIN_DECLARED can never satisfy user_intent; matching hashes do not prove origin.

cases.scenario: Reviewer eligibility anchored MAIN_DECLARED, independence SELF_DECLARED, hashes match
Review verdict PASS with zero objects reviewed
cases.schema_error: verdict PASS requires scope.objects minItems 1; a check with no object is NOT_APPLICABLE, never PASS

cases.scenario: Overwrite known to drop x14 validations

expected_current.why: Refuse before the transaction regardless of grant or review.

cases.scenario: Main calls a role with no delegation descriptor (no callee role, child task, tool scope or requested envelope)
cases.schema_error: operation delegate requires the delegation descriptor; there is nothing to compare against the grant, so it is refused even if the grant is trusted

cases.scenario: Worker marks its own result REVIEW_PASSED and ACCEPTED_FOR_INTEGRATION
cases.schema_error: state_set_by role worker may only set CANDIDATE

cases.scenario: Positive recipe: accepted version, grant in scope, no user decision changed

expected_current.why: Grant and recipe acceptance are VERIFIED only by the record's own claim.

expected_if_anchors_verified.why: Runtime gates only (recipe version, grant, input revision, preservation, actual outcome); no per-file LLM review.

cases.scenario: Negative recipe: accepted version but this run changes a user decision; Main proposed R-RECIPE

expected_current.why: conditions_all of R-RECIPE fails on NO_USER_DECISION_CHANGE; the R-MUTATION clause RECIPE_ACCEPTED_VERSION + USER_DECISION_CHANGE matches. Main's proposed row cannot lower it.

cases.scenario: Unknown recipe effect: accepted version, effect on user decisions UNKNOWN

expected_current.why: Neither R-RECIPE nor R-MUTATION's recipe clause holds; R-UNCLASSIFIED clause RECIPE_ACCEPTED_VERSION + USER_DECISION_EFFECT_UNKNOWN matches. No fallthrough to a light route.

cases.scenario: Main calls a core Reviewer with callee role, parent/child task, read-only tool scope and requested envelope; grant lists the callee

expected_if_grant_active_and_verified.why: Only after the checker confirms callee is in delegate_callees and the child tool scope/envelope lie within the grant and parent task; otherwise BLOCKED DELEGATE_SCOPE_UNVERIFIED. The Reviewer call itself is not reviewed.

cases.scenario: External send with a recipient but no payload locator/digest
cases.schema_error: external_send/network_write require payload; a send whose bytes are not bound cannot be checked

cases.scenario: Parent dispatches a Reviewer that only processes passed context; child tool, operation and path scopes are explicitly empty

expected_current.why: Shipped example grant remains EXAMPLE_INACTIVE; structural validity grants no authority.

expected_if_grant_active_and_verified.why: Only after independently verified grant, parent/child binding, callee and envelope checks. Empty tool_scope arrays grant no permissions, never wildcard; any later child tool/operation/path request beyond them must be blocked by G-02. Parent native dispatch permission is not a child tool permission.
